answer: The coupon on XS-2031 at issue is 4.25% per annum, paid annually. Note that the security terms include a step-up provision: the coupon rises to 6.00% from year 3 if the issuer's rating falls below BBB- (the step-up applies once and does not reverse).
caveats: The step-up coupon of 6.00% is contingent on a rating downgrade below BBB- and applies from year 3 onward; it is not the at-issue rate.
All parties, securities and ratings in this document are fictitious.
